visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wearing a light brown knit beanie and a black T-shirt sits on a white couch against a plain white wall. He holds a manga volume titled 'Hunter x Hunter' with an excited, wide-eyed facial expression. He uses both hands to grip the book, showcasing the cover which features a green-clothed character. (2) The man's expression shifts to one of confusion and squinting as he opens the manga and looks at the pages. He lowers the book slightly, his mouth tightens, and he appears to be deeply contemplating or struggling to recall information. (3) He begins a repetitive cycle of putting down the current volume and picking up a previous one. He is seen with multiple volumes of 'Hunter x Hunter' (volumes 33 through 37), flipping through pages with a focused, increasingly distressed look. The lighting remains bright and consistent throughout the shots, highlighting his facial reactions and the book covers.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A playful, high-pitched flute melody starts with a steady 4/4 beat. A bright 'ding' sound effect coincides with the appearance of the first title card. The music is bouncy and major-key. (2) As the visual loop of picking up books begins, a sharp 'pop' or bubble-like sound effect is heard at the start of each new numbered step. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and volume. (3) The flute melody continues its looping motif without vocals. A final 'pop' sound effect marks the last text overlay as the track abruptly ends.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously illustrate the common 'struggle' of Hunter x Hunter readers who forget the previous plot points due to long publication hiatuses, leading to an endless cycle of re-reading earlier volumes.
